digest.component_or_area: store event append and ticket directory creation
propositions: Ticket directory creation is vulnerable to producing orphaned empty directories if interrupted between os.makedirs and first event file write, leaving MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH debris detectable by fsck.

The fix stages directory and initial event atomically in a dot-prefixed temporary path, then publishes them with a single os.rename under the write lock, making the operation atomic and temp paths invisible to fsck scanners by naming convention.

Multiple code paths share this vulnerability: single-event stage_and_commit, batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission; all are converted to use the new StagedEvent staging and promotion protocol.

A bounded, best-effort sweep removes stale staging directories owned by dead processes at writer startup, using process timestamp and pid-namespace information to avoid pid recycling collisions, without violating the no-writer-cleanup policy for store data.
The fix preserves event byte parity, lock discipline, concurrency semantics (AC3), and fsck scanner behavior with zero scanner changes, relying entirely on existing dot-prefix exclusion rules.
